notes.note: Reviewed the #5627 bounded Windows taskkill diagnostic delta through NodePtyProcess.terminateTree, describeTermination, TerminalSessions.terminate and the adapter owner tests. System32 utility identity and helper spawn/exit/close, exit/signal/kill state plus bounded stdout/stderr tails are new diagnostics; five-second helper and six-second session deadlines, 0/128 success policy, native fallback/ConPTY release, custody, authorization and all POSIX behavior are unchanged. Updated the terminal owner explanation; other cited capability, API, platform, lifecycle and policy claims are unaffected by this diagnostic-only slice. Original intermittent timeout cause remains unconfirmed; baseline receipt regression fails and native adapter owner passes, not causal clearance.
